name: Stacy
source:
Stacy was April's best friend in high school in the town of Foxwoods. She was not only more aesthetically appealing than April, but she was also smarter, more popular, more athletic, and more determined. Not long after graduating from high school, Stacy decided to leave Foxwoods for better career opportunities in a large city. This causes her contact with April to eventually shrink to nothing more than minimal chatter on social media as Stacy pours herself into constructing a career. 

Years later, a successfully refined Stacy returns to Foxwoods for a short time to visit her family and April, who has remained in town with far less accomplishments. Despite the obvious difference in social standing between them, Stacy has much on her mind, and only April is the one she can share these feelings with. Success hasn't been anywhere near easy for Stacy; is she turning to April for support because of their past, or does she want April in her future?
